findings.fix: Confirm pyproject requires-python >=3.11, or skip the pyproject test when tomllib is missing.

summary: The --version flag is plain, conventional and tested through main(), with one source of truth for the version. No blockers; two small notes on the console-script check and tomllib's Python floor.
